from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u097/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a8b5b6d3.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Matching diagonal neighbors define a ray; extend each end through background.
    pairs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    pairs.append((r, c, rr, cc, dr, dc, color))
    for r, c, rr, cc, dr, dc, color in pairs:
        for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
            # Start just outside the pair on the appropriate end.
            if sr == -dr:
                y, x = r - dr, c - dc
            else:
                y, x = rr + dr, cc + dc
            while 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                if out[y][x] != bg:
                    break
                out[y][x] = color
                y += sr
                x += sc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
print('saved', p, 'exists', p.exists())
